out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE POURING POP INTO THE HANDWASHING SINK ACROSS FROM THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: EMPLOYEES RE-EDUCATED. HANDWASHING SINKS MAY NOT BE USED FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PHONES, SMART WATCHES, POCKET KNIFE, AND OTHER PERSONAL ITEMS STORED WITH SINGLE-USE GLOVES, ON PLASTIC WRAP, AND ON FOOD CONTAINERS IN DRY STORAGE. THERE WAS NO CFM PRESENT DURING INSPECTION. PIC STATED SHE HAS ONE FROM A PREVIOUS POSITION, BUT DID NOT HAVE PROOF OF CERTIFICATION WITH HER.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. PERSONAL ITEMS MUST BE KEPT SEPARATE FROM ITEMS FOR RESTAURANT. 2 46.37(a)-(h) - Certified Food Manager, Certification Process A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM) MUST BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE HAVE PIC FIND HER CERTIFICATE OR GET ANOTHER FOOD EMPLOYEE CERTIFIED. I WILL RETURN ON 04/18/2026 FOR A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO ENSURE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS AVAILABLE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM COMPOUND (QAC) solution from the mechanical dispenser, was measured at ABOVE 400PPM. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QAC solution at 150-400 ppm, as listed on the manufacture’s label. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. Adjust or call for service to adjust the concentration to be within the label’s range. In the mean time, dilute the sanitizer to proper the range of concentration , 150-400ppm. CFM diluted the concentration at the 3-vat sink, manually, during the inspection.
